---
title: "S3 Methods"
---

S3 methods for `bgms` and `bgmCompare` objects.

## print {#print}

Print a brief summary of a fitted model.

```r
print(x, ...)
```

## summary {#summary}

Summarize a fitted model with parameter estimates and diagnostics.

```r
summary(object, ...)
```

## coef {#coef}

Extract coefficient estimates.

```r
coef(object, ...)
```

## predict {#predict}

Predict values for new observations.

```r
predict(object, newdata, ...)
```

## simulate {#simulate}

Simulate data from a fitted model.

```r
simulate(object, nsim = 1, ...)
```

::: {.callout-note}
Full documentation for each method to be generated from roxygen.
:::
